name: Hoi An lantern night
summary: On the 14th night of each lunar month the ancient town gives up electric light for candles and lanterns. Local groups keep music, poetry, chess, and traditional theatre. The July 2025 notice does not sell a ticket for the night. The Gregorian date and the hour are check on arrival.
when: The 14th night of each lunar month. The hour is check on arrival.
